account.needHandle: Please set a handle in Settings first.

board.empty: Empty container. Add widgets from the gallery, then drag them in.
board.confirmMessage: It comes off the page straight away. You can add it again from the Widgets Gallery, but anything you typed into it is gone.
board.emptyHint: Drag a widget from the gallery above.

gallery.title: Widgets Gallery
gallery.dragHint: Drag this onto the page. Clicking adds it to the end.
gallery.confirmMessage: Widgets are normally dragged to where you want them. Adding {{widget}} this way puts it at the end of the page, and you can drag it from there.

container.label: Container
container.description: Holds other widgets, in a row, a column or a grid.

account.label: Account
account.description: Your avatar, and the menu behind it.

colophon.label: Colophon
colophon.description: Copyright, build number and the About link.

identity.label: Name and avatar
identity.description: Your avatar, name, handle and headline.

links.label: Links
links.description: The links you list on your profile.

bio.label: Bio (README)
bio.description: Your README post, shown as the bio.

heatmap.label: Activity
heatmap.description: A year of your posting activity.

timeline.label: Posts and media
timeline.description: Everything you have posted, in tabs.

text.label: Text
text.description: A heading and some words of your own.

webamp.label: Winamp
webamp.description: A working Winamp, by way of Webamp. Drop in a file, or point it at one.

spacer.label: Spacer
spacer.description: Empty room, to push things apart or hold a gap open.

title.label: Title
title.description: A word that goes somewhere: one of the app's pages, a path, or a link of your own.

content.label: Page content
content.description: Whatever the current page shows — the feed, a profile, settings.

text.heading: Heading
text.sampleBody: Words of your own, anywhere on your page.

inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.cssNote: Confined to this widget when saved. Rules that could reach outside it — fixed positioning, imports, external URLs — are dropped.
inspector.scrollNote: CSS cannot scroll one axis while the other stays visible, so anything reaching outside this container — a corner badge, a menu — will be clipped on both.
inspector.fontSample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

settings.title: Account
settings.headline: Headline
settings.publicEmailHint: Shown on your profile. Leave empty to hide it.
settings.deleteWarning: Deleting your account permanently removes all your posts and settings. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete your account?

boardInspector.noMedia: You have not posted any media yet.
boardInspector.wallpaperNote: Applies to your profile for everyone who visits it.
boardInspector.resetNote: Puts every board, widget and setting back to the way the app ships.
boardInspector.resetMessage: Every board, widget and setting goes back to the default page. Anything you typed into a widget is lost. This cannot be undone.
boardInspector.enabledNote: A disabled anchor is hidden and refuses widgets dropped on it.

overflow.title: This board is wider than it can show
overflow.inline: Some widgets reach past the right edge and are cut off.
overflow.block: Some widgets reach past the bottom edge and are cut off.
overflow.both: Some widgets reach past the right and bottom edges and are cut off.
overflow.fix: Make the widgets smaller, switch the container to Wrap or Column, or turn scrolling on in its settings.
overflow.scrollable: Scrolling is on, so the rest can be reached — but anything reaching outside a scrolling container is clipped on both axes.

layout.snapNote: Widgets align to cells this tall. Columns come from the board's width.

about.row: One line, no wrapping. Contents shrink rather than run off the page.
about.wrap: One line that folds onto the next when it runs out of room.
about.grid: Even columns. Each widget spans a whole number of them.
about.free: Widgets are placed on a snapping grid, each keeping its own cell and span.
about.anchors: Five slots — top, left, centre, right and bottom. Each widget picks one.

content.notFound: Sorry, the content you are looking for does not exist.
